mentions.name: AltStack.jp
mentions.description: A curated directory of Japanese digital services—cloud hosting, registrars, email providers, and more—all operated in Japan by Japanese companies, helping users find domestic alternatives to foreign platforms. About 20% of the planned categories are live so far.
mentions.problem: Dependence on foreign-operated platforms for digital services.
mentions.audience: People who want to be less dependent on foreign platforms, especially amid the current shift away from globalization.
